test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To leave no stone unturned

options.text: To win everything that is available
To do everything possible to achieve something
To treat someone/something as if of no importance

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom 'To leave no stone unturned' means **to do everything possible to achieve something.**
 
• This** idiom is often used to describe a thorough and exhaustive effort to find or achieve something.**
 
• It suggests that every possible effort or method has been employed to reach a goal.

Hence, the correct meaning of the given idiom is: ***To find the missing document, she left no stone unturned.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The idiom originates from ancient Greek mythology, where the Oracle of Delphi advised a general to search under every stone for a treasure.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of being thorough and diligent in one's efforts.
